title: ServiceRunParams
description: service.run's params: one instance of one of a knowledge base's own services, run once from the image the target's stack documents name, unsupervised, on the caller's document, arguments and environment. contract/LAUNCHER-CONTROL.md, R1-R8.

apiVersion.description: The version of the control API the request is written to.

target.description: The knowledge base whose stack documents name the service's image, and whose stack the instance belongs to: stack.stop of it removes the instance too.

runtime.description: The container runtime to ask, as --runtime names it. Absent: the one the stack's record names, else the first installed one.

document.description: The configuration document's text, written as it is, at the path the image's own arguments name: it need not be JSON. Absent: no file is at that path.

args.description: The arguments the image's program is given in place of the image's own (--config and the document's path). Absent: the image's own.

environment.description: Every variable the instance is given beside the image's own, by name: nothing of the launcher's is added (R2). Empty: none.

mounts.description: Directories of this machine, each mounted read-write at its own path, so that a path the document names is the same inside the instance and out (R4). Empty: none.

pathFirst.description: Directories put before the image's PATH, in order, each mounted at its own path. Empty: the image's PATH as it is.

ports.description: The ports the instance listens on, each published at the same number on the host address (R3). Empty: none.
